people.name: Beth-shemesh
people.line: City in Judah, associated with the Ark's return.

translations.web: The men of Beth Shemesh said, “Who is able to stand before Yahweh, this holy God? To whom shall he go up from us?”
translations.bsb: The men of Beth-shemesh asked, “Who can stand in the presence of the LORD, this holy God? To whom should the ark go up from here?”
translations.kjv: And the men of Bethshemesh said, Who is able to stand before this holy LORD God? and to whom shall he go up from us?
translations.asv: And the men of Beth-shemesh said, Who is able to stand before Jehovah, this holy God? and to whom shall he go up from us?
